source: https://www.chatbase.co/ (inline <svg><title>Chatbase</title> in the header link a[href=/] of nav[aria-label="Main navigation"])
edits: kept only the mark (element 8: the notched block with the C-shaped counter cut out, evenodd)
fixed the viewBox attribute (the HTML parser had lowercased it to 'viewbox') and cropped it with a 2% pad
the source fills with currentColor (the site's text colour); set it to #000000 so the file renders the same everywhere
notes: Chatbase's favicon puts the white mark on a black square tile; no SVG of that tile exists (chatbase-wordmark.svg on the site is letters only), so the light file is the header's black mark and the dark file the same mark in white, which is what the favicon shows.
license: Chatbase brand mark, used nominatively to identify the connected service; trademark rights remain with Chatbase.
